crossRefs.note: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.
“Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty…
Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—
For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
“Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’
“Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways…
You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
I will answer you, and your companions with you.
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
“Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
“Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
“House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says Yahweh. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are…

translations.web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
translations.bsb: Behold, you are not right in this matter. I will answer you, for God is greater than man.
translations.kjv: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
translations.asv: Behold, I will answer thee, in this thou art not just; For God is greater than man.
